body:
This adds the empty state when no hits are returned by the engine. It doesn't change the SFFV no results design.

## Implementation

If no filter are applied, the empty message asks the user to change the query. If there are filters applied, the empty message shows a different message and offers the user to clear the filters.

Since it's not possible to add a widget within another widget template, I used the `ClearRefinements` widget within a panel that is hidden when there are results.

I added `removeWordsIfNoResults` to `allOptional` so that results are returned most of the time.

## Preview

- [Preview with only query leading to empty results](https://deploy-preview-3894--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/?query=hellll)
- [Preview with filters leading to empty results](https://deploy-preview-3894--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/?query=helll&hierarchicalMenu%5BhierarchicalCategories.lvl0%5D%5B0%5D=Cameras%20%26%20Camcorders)
- [Default preview](https://deploy-preview-3894--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/)

## Related

- [Mobile design](https://app.zeplin.io/project/5acc8becfc0c980068fc12cc/screen/5d133b6fc0b0e869459947ca)
